readerCopy.body: A sensitive issue becomes easier to live with once there is a clear plan for what happens next. When Saturn trines Chiron, structure and sensitivity reinforce each other, turning something vague or emotionally loaded into an appointment, boundary, deadline, payment plan, responsibility, or rule that can actually be used. The situation may still be unpleasant. Predictable terms can reduce the uncertainty that kept aggravating it and return attention to what can be done.
